//: Workspace root for webcue, the browser build of SimpleCue. It lives inside the C++ repo because the engine compiles from Source/ — packages/engine builds Source/Audio/CueVoice.cpp to WebAssembly unmodified. Keeping the workspace root here rather than at the repo root leaves the C++ side free of node config. This version is webcue's own and is deliberately independent of the CMake project version, which belongs to the desktop app.
name: webcue
